testcase.name: Scenario: Finish a sketch from a tabs-only ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:551:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Finish a sketch from a tabs-only ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software ✔ And an existing sketch is being edited in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Sketch ribbon is minimized to tabs ✔ When the user clicks the Sketch tab ✔ Then the Sketch command groups appear temporarily beneath the tabs ✔ And the temporary ribbon includes the Finish action ✔ When the user selects Finish ✔ Then sketch editing ends and the part model is displayed ✔ And the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
